physics.reconstruction: selection-subtracted linear velocity-direction proxy from each tracer separately
physics.kernel: exact real-space kernel of a top-hat-smoothed 1/r^2 linear velocity/gravity field

probe_midpoints.source: deterministic full mock LRGxELG DD pairs

random_selection_policy.subset: exact E58 R1 seed, without replacement from full eligible random pool
random_selection_policy.reason: bound runtime and isolate galaxy split-half repeatability; not a final reconstruction-mask convergence claim

repeatability_screen.selection_rule: choose passing tracer with largest minimum-cap median split-half Pearson; if none pass, stop
repeatability_screen.meaning: internal mock repeatability only, not true-velocity calibration

next_if_pass: truth-labelled N-body/lightcone calibration, including reconstruction-mask robustness, before any observed tag
